map.为什么利润要扣货成本？: Why must profit deduct the cost of goods?
map.收入不是利润，卖货还要付进货/生产成本。不扣货成本会把 ROI 算高，误导预算决: Revenue is not profit; selling goods still means paying purchase or production costs. Not deducting cost of goods inflates ROI and misleads budget decisions.
map.ROI 和 ROAS 哪个更该看？: Which matters more, ROI or ROAS?
map.ROAS 看广告效率，ROI 看真实盈利。长期决策应优先 ROI，ROAS 仅作: ROAS measures ad efficiency, ROI measures true profitability. Long-term decisions should prioritize ROI, with ROAS used only for near-term delivery monitoring.
